_comment: Race history for Swim Tools v2 (/fitness-and-training/swim-tools-v2/), keyed by users.json key (= USMS SwimmerID). Parsed from each swimmer's USMS individual results page (comp/meets/indresults.php?SwimmerID=...) saved 2026-10-12, by scratch script; relay leadoff splits, DQ/EXH and events the tools don't offer (25s) left out. Each race: course SCY|SCM|LCM, distance, stroke Free|Back|Breast|Fly|IM, time m:ss.hh, date YYYY-MM-DD, age (the results page's age, which for SCM is age on Dec 31). The page shows the active ?user= persona's races; races a viewer adds or removes are saved per persona in their browser (localStorage swimTools.races.<id>) and replace that list for them.
